title: Controlled synthetic fixtures and scenarios
question: Does each detector trip on the behaviour planted for it and stay quiet on honest twins, and do challenges and external signatures behave as documented?
statement: Planted by construction. These qualify code; they are never a real-world rate and never calibration.
